section number carries through the IBC in the 2015, 2018, 2021, and 2024 editions too.

load or the common path of egress travel distance exceeds the limits in Table 1006.2.1. For an 
eating establishment (Group A-2 assembly occupancy), that table caps a single exit at 49 occupants 
and 75 feet of common path travel -  cross either number and you need two means of egress.
